11.   Current Use of the Property: The subject pronertv is improved with a three-storv mixed-
      use building containing a retail unit at grade and two (2) residential units above.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is proposing to construct a one-storv rear
      addition to expand the floor area of the grade level retail unit from 840 so. ft. to 2.569 so.
      ft. The requested zoning change will permit the resulting floor area ratio.

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to construct a one-storv rear addition to the existing three-storv mixed-use building located
      at the subject site. The expanded grade level retail unit will contain approximately 2.569
      sq. ft. of total floor area. It vvill continue to be occupied bv a dance studio. The two (2)
      existing residential units above will remain vyithout change. The building's existing 34 ft.
      height dimension will remain without change. The subject property is a Transit Served
      Location based on its location along the W. Armitage Ave. Bus Line. No onsite narking
      will be provided.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARC) requires on-site affordable housing units
      and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Plarmed Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit www.cityofchicago.org/ARC for more information). Is this project subject to
      the ARO?

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 5-K in the area bounded by


       West Armitage Avenue; a line 108 feet west of and parallel to North
       Karlov Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Armitage
       Avenue; and a line 133 feet west of and parallel to North Karlov
       Avenue,


to those of a B3-2 Commimity Shopping District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.




Common Address of Property;         4111 W. Armitage Ave.
